name: meditrack-monorepo
description: MediTrack – Smart Medicine Inventory and Expiry Management System

scripts.start:dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const b = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'backend', shell: true, stdio: 'inherit' }); const f = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'frontend', shell: true, stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install

author: MediTrack Team
